register_to_vote.prompt: How do I register to vote?
register_to_vote.title: Register to Vote
register_to_vote.summary: Complete registration before the deadline so you can vote in the election.
steps: Check that you meet your local eligibility rules.
Gather any required identification or address documents.
Submit your registration online, by mail, or in person if allowed.
Confirm that your registration status is active before election day.
details: If your name or address changes, update your registration as soon as possible.
Some places require you to register several weeks before the election.

voting_process.title: Voting Process
voting_process.summary: Follow these steps to cast a ballot confidently and correctly.
steps: Find your assigned polling place or review your mail-in ballot instructions.
Bring any required identification or voter materials.
Review the ballot carefully and mark your choices.
Submit the ballot according to the instructions provided.
details: Read the ballot instructions before you start.
Ask poll workers for help if you are unsure how to proceed.

election_timeline.title: Election Timeline
election_timeline.summary: Use the timeline to plan registration, voting, and follow-up steps.
steps: Check absentee or early voting dates if available.
Confirm the final election day and polling hours.
Track any post-election updates or certification dates.
details: Add the deadlines to your calendar early.
Verify official election dates with your local election office.
